WITH item_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    c.town_city,
    AVG(ili.product_price) as item_price_avg,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_total_cost != 0 AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL 
        THEN CAST(ili.derived_product_cost AS REAL) / CAST(ili.derived_total_cost AS REAL)
        ELSE NULL END) as item_ratio_avg
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    town_city,
    AVG(item_price_avg) as avg_price,
    AVG(item_ratio_avg) as avg_ratio
  FROM item_averages
  GROUP BY town_city
),
global_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(ili.derived_product_cost AS REAL) / CAST(ili.derived_total_cost AS REAL)) as global_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  WHERE ili.derived_total_cost != 0 AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ta.town_city,
  ta.avg_price,
  ta.avg_ratio,
  ta.avg_ratio - ga.global_ratio as ratio_excess
FROM town_averages ta
CROSS JOIN global_average ga
WHERE ta.avg_ratio > ga.global_ratio
ORDER BY ta.avg_ratio DESC
